app.name: Training tracker
app.tagline: Log a session without fighting a form.

storage.unavailableBody: This browser is blocking local storage, so anything you log will disappear when you close the tab. Private browsing is the usual cause.

empty.title: Nothing logged yet
empty.body: Log your first session and your trend starts here.

chart.emptyNoDataBody: Log your first session and your trend will start building here.
chart.emptyInRangeBody: You have sessions logged, just none in this window. Try a longer range.
chart.errorBody: Your data is safe — this is a display problem, not a lost session.
chart.summaryWithGoal: {points} days shown. Total {total}, averaging {average} per day. Goal is {goal} per day.
chart.summary: {points} days shown. Total {total}, averaging {average} per day.

describe.heading: Describe your week
describe.intro: Type what you did in your own words. We'll turn it into sessions for you to check before anything is saved.
describe.placeholder: ran 5k, 30 min yoga, cycled an hour on Saturday

results.heading: Found {count, plural, =0 {no sessions} one {one session} other {# sessions}}
results.none: We couldn't find any sessions in that. Try naming the activity and how long it took — for example "ran 5k" or "45 min strength".
results.reviewNote: Check these over — nothing is saved until you say so.
results.save: Save {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}
results.estimatedExplanation: We worked this out rather than reading it from your text.

source.fallbackExplanation: The assistant wasn't available, so we used the built-in parser. It's simpler, so check the results a little more carefully.

errors.networkBody: Check your connection and try again — nothing you typed was lost.
errors.rateLimitedBody: Give it about {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.tooLongBody: Trim it down and try again — a few sentences works best.
errors.unknownBody: Nothing you typed was lost. Try again when you're ready.

saved.title: {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} saved
saved.failedBody: Nothing was lost — they're still here. Try again when you're ready.

fields.distanceOptional: Optional — leave blank for activities you don't measure in distance

errors.activityRequired: Give the session a name so you'll recognise it later.
errors.dateRequired: Pick the day this session happened.
errors.dateInFuture: That date is in the future.
errors.durationRequired: Enter how long the session lasted.
errors.durationInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes.

failure.title: Couldn't save that session
failure.body: Nothing was lost — your entry is still here. Try again when you're ready.
